- Intended use: prototyping and live demos (non-production)

Best,

Hi Eleanor — thanks for sending the roster. Quick clarifying Qs before I loop in Ops for issuance:  

1) Are these startups new Redwood accounts (self-serve signups) or will you provision them under a single corporate account? We prefer issuing per-account promo codes tied to individual emails.
2) Will any of the cohort be on existing enterprise contracts or Dedicated customers? That impacts eligibility.
3) Can you provide a signed W9 or equivalent accreditation doc (for US tax records)?

If you can confirm those three items I’ll start the internal approval and attach Neha (partner ops) to get the promo codes staged. Our standard for accelerator grants is: one-time promo per company, 180-day expiry, non-transferable, and usage tracked in HubSpot. If you need invoice-level credits or special billing terms we can escalate, but that adds 1–2 days to the process.

Thanks — I’ll aim to follow up with a draft issuance plan tomorrow.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

Subject: FW: LaunchPad cohort — request for promotional grant (10 startups)

Neha / Marissa — forwarding LaunchPad's ask. TL;DR: 10 x $10k promo credits to be issued as unique per-startup promo codes (180-day expiry). They provided a roster and accreditation.

Why I recommend approval:
- LaunchPad is a repeat partner; their demo workloads are low risk and likely to convert to paid usage.
- Grant size is $100k total; within our partner promotional band for accelerator programs.

Risks / asks:
- Need formal verification (W9 + accreditation). Eleanor said she can provide those (attaches in thread).
- Promo issuance will create temporary quota reservations; Ops should confirm no conflict with current capacity forecasts.
- Marketing wants to track promo redemptions via a dedicated HubSpot campaign (deal LP-2026-042).

Proposal for issuance (please sign off):
- Format: one unique promo code per company (100% credit until depleted)
- Expiry: 180 days from issuance
- Redemption limit: no more than $10,000 applied per account
- Delivery: send codes to Eleanor to distribute to founders

If approved I’ll instruct Ops to generate codes and attach the approval letter. Neha — can you confirm whether we need legal to sign an accelerator addendum (I think not for self-serve grants) and whether Finance needs the W9 before codes go live?

Thanks — Rishi

- 10 promo codes, $10,000 credit each (total $100k)
- Codes valid for 180 days from issuance; single-use per account; non-transferable

What we need from you (to finalize issuance)
1) Confirm whether you want codes distributed to founders directly or to your partnership team for distribution.
2) Upload signed W9 and the accreditation letter to the Drive folder linked below.

Delivery & attachments
- Attached: promo_codes.csv (stub with placeholder codes), LaunchPad_approval_letter.pdf (internal approval letter).
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/LP-2026-042 (we'll track redemptions here)

Notes on billing & monitoring
- These are promotional credits applied against usage; after credits are exhausted normal billing applies.
- We'll share a weekly redemption snapshot with you for the first 60 days.

Please confirm the distribution preference and upload the W9; once we have that Neha will trigger code issuance and email the batch to you.

Thanks and excited to see what the cohort builds!

— Rishi
